elements.label: 'Save' button swaps to green 'Saved' with checkmark
Set Hotkey panel tints from dark grey to green
Hotkey keycaps (option, command, V) turn green

pattern.description: On confirm, the 'Save' button is replaced by a green 'Saved' with a checkmark while the whole hotkey panel and its keycaps wash to a green success tint at once.
pattern.why_premium: The confirmation is shown by a single coordinated state change (label, icon, panel tint and keycap colour together) rather than a toast, so the success reads instantly; the brand-green tint is subtle on a dark glass panel and stays on screen.

build_hint.gsap: tl.to('.save-btn', {opacity: 0, duration: 0.08}).fromTo('.saved', {opacity: 0, x: 4}, {opacity: 1, x: 0, duration: 0.15, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<').to(['.panel', '.keycap'], {backgroundColor: 'var(--success-tint)', color: 'var(--success)', duration: 0.2, ease: 'power2.out'}, '<').
build_hint.remotion: p = interpolate(frame, [t, t+5], [0, 1], {extrapolateRight: 'clamp', easing: Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); interpolateColors(p, [0, 1], [grey, green]) for panel and keycaps; Saved opacity = p, Save opacity = 1 - p.

notes: The filmstrip crop shows the card drifting/scaling slightly through the burst (camera.move none, scale sum 1.07), read as a slow whole-panel drift, not a camera move; 'Clipboard History' (b03) only drifts with it and is not listed. A click-like transient near 8.48 s on the spectrogram has no SFX candidate, so none was reviewed.
